meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用约束模型计算代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除带来的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用约束模型研究代谢网络、做通量或基因敲除分析。
copy.tagline_en: Model metabolic networks to compute fluxes and predict gene knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study metabolic networks with constraint-based models.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能加载基因组尺度代谢模型(SBML/JSON/YAML),执行 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样、产率包络和缺口填补分析,并输出通量分布、生长速率等结果。
howto.when: 当你要求加载或导出代谢模型、运行 FBA、FVA 等通量分析,或做基因敲除等分析时触发。

say.text: 加载 textbook 模型跑一次 FBA,告诉我生长速率
say.note: 返回目标值和各反应通量

say.text: 对 iJO1366 做单基因敲除,列出必需基因
say.note: 返回生长低于阈值的基因

say.text: 算出支持 50% 最大生长的最小培养基
say.note: 返回培养基组分与用量

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can load genome-scale metabolic models (SBML/JSON/YAML), run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, production envelopes and gapfilling, returning flux distributions, growth rates and knockout results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to load, build or export a metabolic model, run FBA, FVA or flux sampling, or do gene/reaction knockouts, media optimization and gapfilling.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model and run FBA; tell me the growth rate.
Run single gene deletion on iJO1366 and list essential genes.
Compute the minimal medium supporting 50% of max growth.
